review_evidence: The 94 primary Lean files develop classical and quantum information theory, probability/entropy, channels, matrix/isometry/minimax infrastructure, regularization, Hamiltonians and ideal-gas thermodynamics with extensive definitions and theorems.

Representative theorem-bearing files include ClassicalInfo/Prob.lean, ClassicalInfo/Distribution.lean, QuantumInfo/ForMathlib/Isometry.lean, QuantumInfo/ForMathlib/Minimax.lean and StatMech/IdealGas.lean.
The complete 15-line lakefile.lean only selects Mathlib and declares the QuantumInfo, ClassicalInfo and StatMech Lake libraries.

rules.content_invariant: Complete inspection shows only Lake package configuration, a pinned Mathlib dependency and lean_lib declarations; all mathematical definitions, statements, proofs and interfaces remain in retained source files.
rules.rationale: This exact file is Lake package/dependency/library configuration around the retained information-theory and statistical-mechanics libraries.

summary: Reviewed Lean-QuantumInfo; retain its quantum/classical information theory and statistical-mechanics formalization, excluding only Lake package configuration.
